DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = dateadd(dd,-1,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE))  FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO];


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.CORP_MISC_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CORP_MISC_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
